listing.title: Wedding Vendor Tracker Excel Template: Quote Comparison, True Cost, Contract Deadlines, Vendor Contact Sheet, Cancellation Terms
listing.headline: Compare every quote on its true cost and never miss a contract date
listing.description:
Keep every wedding vendor in one Excel workbook. Built for an engaged couple planning their own wedding, with a parent or a day-of coordinator who gets a printed page. No vendor ever sees your details.

Vendors holds every slot from first enquiry to the day: venue, caterer, photographer, videographer, band or DJ, florist, officiant, cake baker, hair and makeup, attire shop, tailor, stationery printer, rentals, transport, day-of coordinator and hotel room block. Quotes holds up to three options for each with every extra: service charge, taxes, delivery, overtime, travel and an optional tip, so the true total of each quote is clear. Scoring Weights, True-Cost Table and Category Winners rank the quotes on price and on your own ratings of fit, reply and reviews, with weights you edit.

Contract Items records what each booked contract includes and excludes, the cancellation terms, the final headcount and final payment dates, arrival and set-up and the overtime rate. Contract Deadlines puts every date, unpaid payment and quote expiry in one list with red, amber and green from your own limits. Pipeline by Category shows the latest booking date for each open category from its typical lead time.

18 tools answer weekly questions: which quote is really cheapest, which fits best, how much the second quote must drop to win, whether a quote fits its budget line, which vendor has missing terms, when the final headcount is due, what a cancellation could cost, whether two vendors clash on the day and who to call today. Print 12 sheets and 12 pages, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to vendors, the day-of coordinator and your partner.

A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Every default is a typical starting value you can edit, and every estimate is your own. It is not a booking service, not a payment service and not legal, tax or insurance advice. This is part three of the Wedding Planning suite.
